title: Zugzwang Squeeze
setup: Your queen owns half the board, but a queen alone cannot finish — the king has to take the last squares away.
hint: No check wins here. Find the quiet king step that leaves Black exactly one legal move.
explanation:
## The Idea

A **zugzwang**: the winning move makes no threat at all. It simply leaves Black one legal move, and that move loses.

{{Kg6}} is quiet. Now g7 and h7 belong to your king and the queen on a3 covers f8, so Black's only move is {{Kg8}}, onto the back rank. {{Qa8#}} takes the whole of it, and f7, g7 and h7 are your king's.

When every check lets the king slip, stop checking and take squares instead.
